resources.string: Sign-in gives access to your backups. Restoring still requires the backup password.
Keeps your latest three cloud backups. Uploading another replaces the oldest.
Delete this cloud backup? Other backups stay.
Delete cloud account and all backups? Local data will remain.
Backups deleted. Finish deleting your account.
Signing out keeps your uploaded backups and this device\'s data.
Cloud backups are not available in this build. Local data works as usual.
No connection. Your local data is unchanged.
Cloud quota reached. Try again later or export an encrypted file.
This backup has changed. Refresh the list.
The last change may or may not have been saved. Refresh the list before trying again.
The stored backup failed verification. Nothing was restored.
Sign in again to confirm this change.
The cloud request failed. Your local data is unchanged.
Download a backup, then enter its backup password to restore it.
We’ll open your browser to sign in with Google. Daftar never sees your Google password.
Finish signing in in your browser
Return to Daftar after approving. You can cancel here. This attempt expires after 3 minutes.
Couldn’t open your browser. Check that a default browser is set, then try again.
Sign-in wasn’t completed. You can try again.
